Barack Obama is an American politician and former president of the United States. He was the 44th president, serving from 2009 to 2017, and the first African American elected to the office. Barack Obama Presidential Library The Obama Foundation
Barack Obama, official presidential portrait
Barack Obama speaking as U.S. president
Background: Born in Honolulu, Hawaii, on August 4, 1961, Obama studied law and worked as a community organizer and civil-rights attorney in Chicago before entering politics. - Political career: He served in the Illinois State Senate and the U.S. Senate before winning the presidency in 2008.
